verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents its own MCP server that lets coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Zed) list services, run SQL, and read monitoring over OAuth 2.1, so a user can operate it with natural-language prompts through an external agent. Agent-oriented features back this up: CHKit typed commands an agent can drive, isolated read-only compute and branches for agent runs, and full query logging. However, natural-language operation depends on a third-party agent, and the product ships no native natural-language console or text-to-SQL interface. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface, documented coverage of administrative operations (scaling, alerts, backups) through natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration.
